    row_cost_col = None
    for c in range(1, max_used_col + 1):
        v = ws.cell(r, c).value
        if isinstance(v, str):
            txt = v.strip().lower()

                row_day_col = c
            elif txt == "cost":

answer_cell.number_format = source_cell.number_format
answer_cell.font = copy(source_cell.font)
answer_cell.fill = copy(source_cell.fill)
answer_cell.border = copy(source_cell.border)
answer_cell.alignment = copy(source_cell.alignment)
answer_cell.protection = copy(source_cell.protection)

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

verify_ws = verify_wb.active

saved_value = verify_ws["F11"].value

# Recompute independently from saved workbook using the detected reference-table layout.
recomputed = None

    combined = verify_ws.cell(r, day_col).value
